extraction.Name: Lena Lima Bordeaux
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 15, 1918 by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Land mortgaged by Lima Bordeaux LaPointe and husband to the Valentine State Bank for $1075; agreement entered July 5, 1919 with Whittemore and Lewis Investment Company deed in escrow between Lima Bordeaux Lapointe and her husband and Edward A. Heuer, payment of $100 down and $2700 on or before; then Mrs. Lapointe and her husband conveyed by deed to O. M. Walcott for $2500 subject to the two mortgages which Walcott assumed and agreed to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612448 issued; Lots 3 and 4 and East half of Southwest quarter section 7, township 37, north of range 25; receipt for the patent was signed by the allottee January 24, 1918; land first mortgaged for $1000; then mortgaged to Valentine State Bank for $1075; deed in escrow with Whittemore and Lewis Investment Company and Edward A. Heuer dated August 18, 1919; final conveyance to O. M. Walcott for $2500 subject to two mortgages; document appears incomplete/fragmentary
